text: In 1838 young Thomas Hutter leaves the town of Wisborg to sell a derelict house to Count Orlok, [travelling deep into the Carpathians|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] to a castle where his host admires a portrait of Hutter's wife Ellen and her "lovely neck". Orlok sails for Wisborg [among coffins full of rats|images|vermin and creeping things], and the town fills with deaths blamed on [a plague from the ship|threat|sickness and poison]. Ellen reads that only a pure-hearted woman's blood, freely given, can hold him past dawn, and she [opens her window to let him in|rules|it must be let in].
